steps.content: You rush to Wing City. Just as you've seen on the way, the Ice Plague has crossed the Forbidden Wall and is threatening the east.

The city gate was bustling in the last round. But now, Wing City's gate is completely frozen. Even the city's entire west side suffers the same fate. In between the two sides, a smaller version of the Forbidden Wall is being constructed.
You see Hella in a glamorous outfit tweaking machine parts. She seems highly concentrated and serious, like a real castellan.
A familiar figure follows Hella around. It's Tetya. Due to the sudden threat of the Ice Plague, the young swordswoman has sheathed her sword and is working together with Wing City's people.
Good. She didn't really die.
You draw in a deep breath and look at your allies in this round.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What can we do?

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: Give them the <color=#fb9259>Dragonstones</color> we've stolen. Hold out for as long as possible.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: With the current severity of the Ice Plague, 100,000 Dragonstones can only last us 36 hours.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: I know, but it's better than nothing.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: We should go to <color=#fb9259>Cyrus</color> of Dragonberg. The worsening of the Ice Plague must have something to do with him.
Erwin neglects the Chosen One's influence on the Ice Plague. This means Cyrus must have done something... Or, he's simply trying to guide you to the right path of the storyline.
<size=40>Ignorant Dragon's Children, the great Dragon of Genesis has descended!</color>
<size=40>Sacrifice your blood and become one with the marvelous Cyrus!</color>
With the thunderous mechanical rumbling, the dark shadow looms in the sky over Wing City. Cyrus has come directly to Wing City in this round.
The monster attacks the city. Hmm, the Game Master sure likes clichés. If she didn't manipulate the plot, why would Cyrus strike Wing City at this juncture?
What's the thing that was absent in Wing City before, but is present now?

Wing City seems well prepared for the massive flying beast's ambush. Mechanical cannons are stationed on the east side and troops of Wing City soldiers rise into the sky with the help of flying robots.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: Let's show them what we've got, Chosen One!
Tierney calls out to you heroically, but amid the dragon's roars and the wailing wind, you seem to hear something else.

steps.speaker: Tierney
steps.content: This big guy has more parts than all the Dragonstones we've hoarded. Strip it down and sell them, and we'll never have to work a day for the rest of our lives!
